mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_seen(run_id,business_key) values (#{runId},#{businessKey}) on conflict do nothing

insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff(run_id,business_key,difference_type,source_version,target_version,repaired) values (#{runId},#{businessKey},#{differenceType},#{sourceVersion},#{targetVersion},#{repaired}) on conflict(run_id,business_key) do nothing

insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff(run_id,business_key,difference_type,target_version) select #{runId},,'MISSING_SOURCE',source_version from integration_schema.cost_center integration_schema.exchange_rate t where not exists(select 1 from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_seen s where s.run_id=#{runId} and s.business_key=) on conflict(run_id,business_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select count(*) from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff where run_id=#{runId} and repaired=false
select * from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff where run_id=#{runId} order by id limit 100
